error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code.
path_rule: lstat /var/log/audit; when absent, the nearest existing ancestor; a stat error other than absence is ERROR auditd-log-space:stat-failed
source_rule: fstec-logging-2025 main item 5 requires a security event log storage size sufficient for full analysis without a value; by user decision 30.09.2026 (auditd segmentation map v5/v6) the control is CHECK only: at least 7 GiB available in the file system of /var/log/audit (estimate for three months from the 30.09.2026 measurement)
value_rule: VALUE is f_bavail * f_frsize of statvfs as a decimal integer of bytes; PASS when it is at least 7516192768 (7 * 2^30), otherwise FAIL; a statvfs error is ERROR auditd-log-space:statvfs-failed
